## About
Alpha Transmissions Auto Repair is a transmission shop on McHenry Rd in Wheeling. We work on cars, vans and trucks, and we handle new and rebuilt transmissions.
Customers tell us they appreciate being walked through the problem. A reviewer said Arturo was thorough in laying out the options, and another said Abel took the time to show the parts he replaced.
We're rated 5 stars from 29 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transmission repair: Transmission repair for cars, vans and trucks. A reviewer had their commercial Ram Promaster van diagnosed and fixed here.
- New and rebuilt transmissions: When a repair isn't enough, we install new or rebuilt transmissions. A reviewer chose a rebuild and said the final cost matched the quote.
- Free estimates and road test: We'll look at your vehicle, take it for a road test and give you an estimate at no charge. (Free)

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer towing?
A: Yes. Towing is free with a major transmission repair within the Wheeling area.

Q: How long does an estimate take?
A: Contact us and we'll have your estimate ready within 20 minutes.
